confirmedFindings.title: Value receiver copies sync.RWMutex, eliminating concurrency synchronization
confirmedFindings.body: Defining Set and Get with a value receiver func (s Store) copies the sync.RWMutex on each call, meaning locks operate on independent mutex copies and provide zero concurrency protection.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Change the method receiver to a pointer receiver: func (s *Store) Set(...) and func (s *Store) Get(...)
